It causes me motion sickness from the slow downs since I have a slower system
@{602adeac1b8f79100ec2b86b|full_name}: ugh this bug's back again? I used snap turning for my first year of VRC because this used to happen and I couldn't stand it!
I'm so used to the speed I've been used to, it's too slow and frustrating.
I get screen-sick and would like it to be reverted or the speed to be selectable.

Happens on PCVR too. They specifically stated input is no longer dependent on framerate (it never was before), now it actually is. You can see the issue in action here:
https://gfycat.com/closedecentcony
The lower my framerate is the slower I'm turning.
@{5f30421bda52487c3a337b91|full_name}: "it never was before", well it USED to be, but that was a few years back.

@{5e5961740ab4231b6f14d29c|full_name}: 
According to a previous comment yes. I wasn't in VRChat back then. But if you want it to be accurate, virtual keyboard input (such as the login) and desktop controls were also framerate dependent (cost me quite a lot of tries in Devouring back then due to a frame hitch at the very moment you had to turn exactly 90° often resulting in the input being extrapolated and making you spin wildly)
Not sure if they still are but that seems to be a basic Unity issue to begin with.

@{6223dd335cb08367f48eba41|full_name}: Input is no longer frame rate dependent.
With this update of Beta, the frame rate of the application and the mouse and controller stick swivel inputs are now completely separated.
(The mouse was originally separated, but the app itself still seems to be designed to assume the frame rate.)
Presumably, the app's turning process itself is still likely to be frame-rate dependent.
(The mouse is in trouble, it shouldn't be doing it, but it is using old code to make the turning speed dependent on the frame rate. As a result, even with this BETA, when encountering a scene with high processing load, the turning speed increases in the opposite direction.)
The easiest solution would be to replacement the mouse and controller stick turning process on the BETA....

We are pleased that the beta has resulted in the implementation of PB and many much-anticipated features.
However, I am also happy to see that the avatar's turning speed has been slowed down considerably (80%?). This may be a good change for new users to make them feel less intoxicated, but for existing users it will only make it harder for them to move. Please either revert back to the original version, or make it possible to change the maximum rotation speed.
